spanish: Y subió tendido del rocío, y he aquí sobre faz del desierto, fino escamado, fino como escarcha sobre la tierra.
grammarChanges: Moved the comma to follow 'desierto' so 'fino escamado' and 'fino como escarcha' stand as two parallel דק phrases, instead of binding the first one to desierto as its modifier.
Dropped the article before escarcha ('como la escarcha' -> 'como escarcha') because כפור is absolute with no article in this generic comparison.
readerNote: Comma repositioned after desierto and the article before escarcha dropped so the two parallel fino phrases and the generic frost comparison match the tokens; faz is kept for the plural construct פני since the sense remains one face/surface, as the audit itself notes.
